IS 10096 : Part 1 : Sec 2 : 2014 : Recommendations for Inspection, Testing and Maintenance of Radial Gates and Rope Drum Hoists Part 1 Inspection, Testing and Assembly at the Manufacturing Stage Section 2 Rope drum hoistsICS 93.160WRD 12Reaffirmed 20191. Scope1.1 This standard (Part 1/Sec 2) lays down the recommendations for inspection, testing and assembly of rope drum hoists for radial gates at the manufacturing stage.1.2 This standard may be applicable for rope drum hoists for other types of gates as well.2. References2.1 The standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below.325 : 1996 Three-phase induction motors - Specification (fifth revision)919 ISO Systems of limits and fits:(Part 1) : 1993 Bases of tolerance, deviations and fits (second revision)(Part 2) : 1993 Tables of standard tolerance grades and limit deviations for holes and shafts (first revision)1573 : 1986 Specification for electroplated coatings of zinc on iron and steel (second revision)4460 (Parts 1 to Gears - Spur and helical gears - 3) : 1995 Calculation of load capacity (first revision)14177 : 1994 Guidelines for painting system for hydraulic gates and hoists
